corrections.before:
Consider the following statements about Article 15(6).
1. It was inserted by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019.
2. Reservation under it may be additional to existing reservations, subject to a maximum of ten percent.
3. Minority educational institutions referred to in Article 30(1) are excepted.
Which statements are correct?
corrections.after:
Consider the following statements about Article 15(6).
1. It was inserted by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019.
2. Under clause (6)(b), reservation in educational admissions may be additional to existing reservations, subject to a maximum of ten percent of the total seats in each category.
3. Minority educational institutions referred to in Article 30(1) are excepted.
Which statements are correct?

1. It was inserted by the 103rd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2019.
2. Under clause (6)(b), reservation in educational admissions may be additional to existing reservations, subject to a maximum of ten percent of the total seats in each category.

corrections.before:
ప్రకరణ 15(6) గురించి కింది ప్రకటనలను పరిశీలించండి.
1. దీనిని 2019 నాటి 103వ రాజ్యాంగ సవరణ చేర్చింది.
2. దీనికింద రిజర్వేషన్ ఇప్పటికే ఉన్న రిజర్వేషన్లకు అదనంగా, గరిష్ఠంగా పది శాతానికి లోబడి ఉండవచ్చు.
3. ప్రకరణ 30(1)లోని మైనారిటీ విద్యాసంస్థలు మినహాయించబడ్డాయి.
సరైన ప్రకటనలు ఏవి?

సరైన ప్రకటనలు ఏవి?
